data.title: Question Words — Starter · Lesson 3
data.subject: questions
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Alright now) Hey there, let's go

[Hook]
What's your name?… ¿Cómo te llamas?
Nice to meet you… Mucho gusto
Where do you live?… ¿Dónde vives?
Let's be friends… Seamos amigos
Come hang out today.

[Verse]
New neighbors, moving in,
gotta learn some Spanish to begin.
How old are you?… ¿Cuántos años tienes?
This is fun, let's see what happens.
What time is it?… ¿Qué hora es?
Time to explore and find the keys.
Whose is this?… ¿De quién es esto?
A new adventure, let's go fast.

[Hook]
What's your name?… ¿Cómo te llamas?
Nice to meet you… Mucho gusto
Where do you live?… ¿Dónde vives?
Let's be friends… Seamos amigos
Come hang out today.

[Verse]
Who do you live with?… ¿Con quién vives?
A simple question, let's dive in.
What is it for?… ¿Para qué sirve?
Learning new words, it's so nice.
Since when have you been studying?… ¿Desde cuándo estudias?
Spanish is cool, we’re getting busy.
Where are you going tomorrow?… ¿Adónde vas mañana?
Adventure awaits, let's go play.

[Bridge]

vocab.en: Since when have you been studying?
